data: © Soviet Academy of Sciences — orbiter component of Mars 3 mission, returned data through 1972.

Orbital component of the Mars 3 mission. Returned the first surface temperature and atmospheric measurements of Mars from orbit. Made eight months of observations before contact was lost in August 1972.
First Soviet Mars orbiter; first to deliver a soft-landing payload to another planet.
First spacecraft to soft-land on Mars
The Soviet / Russian heavy-lift workhorse 1967-2012 — Salyut, Mir, Venera, Vega, Luna sample-return
First soft landing on Mars; 14.5 s of surface transmission
